title: MalisisDoorsReforged
description: New animations for doors. You can build you own doors with millions of possibilities!
body:
Malisis Doors Refroged

Malisis Doors  Refroged is a community-driven port of the original Malisis Doors,Malisis Block, Malisis Switch project to modern Minecraft versions.

This project aims to preserve the look, feel, and functionality of the original mod while updating it for current modding platforms and game versions.

Disclaimer

Warning 1 – Animation Accuracy

Due to the complexity of the original mod and changes in modern Minecraft modding APIs, some animations may not perfectly match the original Malisis Doors implementation. While many animations have been carefully recreated, certain behaviors may differ slightly from the original version.

Every effort has been made to reproduce the original experience as closely as possible.

Warning 2 – Future Updates

Because of the technical complexity of this project, future updates and ports to newer Minecraft versions cannot be guaranteed. Support for future versions will depend on available development time and the feasibility of maintaining compatibility.

Credits
Original [Malisis Doors](https://github.com/Ordinastie/MalisisDoors) project by Ordinastie
Modern port, maintenance, and adaptations by Mickdev
Important Notice

This project is an unofficial port and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. All rights to the original assets, concepts, and designs remain with their respective owners.
